caption:
four apps, four pieces of the story, never the picture

#applehealth #oura #wearabletech

slides.text:
Four apps.
Four pieces of the story.

The ring has the night

The watch has the workout

The food app has lunch

Apple Health has all of it
and an opinion about none of it
One place they all report to

And one answer
instead of four dashboards

slides.heading: The picture, not the pieces
slides.body: SOMA connects the devices you already wear and reasons across them — no new hardware, no fifth app to check
